The amendment requires us to give the distributor a 30-day cure period before we can terminate the agreement. It also mandates arbitration in Dallas for disputes and expressly permits emergency injunctive relief. I have not yet incorporated this amendment into the matter summary, so I wanted to make sure everyone was aware before we finalize our approach.

Yesterday I confirmed in a call with the company's hospital-sales leadership that preserving uninterrupted distributor deliveries is the client's primary objective.
